name: 48216 · Detroit, MI
findings: ZIP 48216 (Detroit) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48216 (Detroit) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48216 (Detroit) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 12.6 times the typical level).
